_doc: Team research shown as a tab on dc-delay-risk.html (build_dc_delay.py: team_views). The HTML is Daniel's file exactly as received on 2026-11-09 (Downloads/dc_matrix_standalone.html), stored unchanged and embedded in a sandboxed frame. To update the tab: drop the new file here, point 'file' at it, bump 'asof'/'received', rebuild.
author: Daniel (Capstone research)
title: US data center build matrix: states × companies
summary: 183 projects in 34 states plus a multi-state row, under 10 company groups (end user where disclosed or credibly reported); each state row carries Daniel's post-election friendliness rank, SemiAnalysis's 2028 GW where printed, and the regulatory state of play. Click a cell for project MW, partners, status, confidence and source.
caveats: MW are headline figures in mixed units (IT, power or utility load, full-build or permit capacity), not our IT-eq basis: cell totals show concentration and are not additive forecasts.
Rank is Daniel's post-election data-center friendliness ranking (1 = friendliest) from the DC Regulation knowledge base; the 'SA' figure is SemiAnalysis's 2028 net additions (2026-11-01).
Includes Wells Fargo and FUNDA material marked internal only: keep the page on internal channels.
